subject: english
stem: Claim: Short practice sessions can improve accuracy. Which case is relevant support?
options: A player wore new shoes during a game.
A ball was placed in a bag.
A player practiced ten minutes daily and made fewer passing errors.

optionRationales.reason: A player wore new shoes during a game.：無 practice/accuracy 關係。
A coach prefers morning games.：是意見。
A ball was placed in a bag.：無關。
A player practiced ten minutes daily and made fewer passing errors.：短時練習與 accuracy improvement 都有。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 A player practiced ten minutes daily and made fewer passing errors.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 A player practiced ten minutes daily and made fewer passing errors. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
